response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT p.death_country AS death_country, AVG(v.points_won) AS avg_points FROM player_award_vote v JOIN player p ON p.player_id = v.player_id WHERE v.points_won IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.death_country) SELECT death_country, avg_points, avg_points - (SELECT AVG(avg_points) FROM c) AS diff_from_avg_of_avgs FROM c
